title: Beyond Paradise (TV series)
premise_summary: Beyond Paradise is a crime television series that acts as a spin-off of the long-running series Death in Paradise. It stars Kris Marshall and Sally Bretton. The BBC announced that it had commissioned the spin-off on 29 June 2022. The first series of six episodes aired weekly from 24 February 2023 to 7 April 2023.
